description: This Java interface defines the GatewayMapper component responsible for mapping devices to their last used gateway within the Eclipse Hono client project. It includes a factory method for creating instances and a method to retrieve the mapped gateway device ID asynchronously.

classes.name: GatewayMapper
classes.description: An interface for mapping devices to their last used gateway, including a factory method and a method to retrieve the mapped gateway device ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a GatewayMapper instance using default implementation, requiring registration client factory, device connection client factory, and tracer.

methods.name: getMappedGatewayDevice
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the gateway device ID for a given device, returning a Future that may succeed with the ID or fail with specific exceptions.
